entities.summary: Vilma Bobeck is a Swedish sailor. She competed in the 49er FX event at the 2024 Summer Olympics, where she won the silver medal in the women's 49er FX event together with Rebecca Netzler. Bobeck also has four World championship medals in the 49er FX, including one gold, and one in the Europe dinghy.
